scope: Authored translation assumptions; inert data, no parser output, review, admission or independent evidence.

identityPolicy.defaultProfile: Each case is isolated; contextIri declares its local interpretation. Bare KIF constants are global only inside that separately selected case.
identityPolicy.entityEquality: Only exact declared term identity within the selected profile; never subjectCid == sourceCid as a fallback.
identityPolicy.englishCarrier: A later reviewed English carrier must enforce one context, current single snapshot, and class/individual sort consistency. These JSON declarations are not that carrier.
identityPolicy.manualKif: Pure taxonomy does not enforce class/individual disjointness. Explicit manual global union/punning requires declared assumptions; C3 intentionally combines global names.

sortInterpretation.synthetic-proposition-term: offline NAL term, outside taxonomy sorts
sortInterpretation.suggested-class: unreviewed suggestion, no approved class assertion

sourceDependencePolicy: English and KIF companions are authored representations of one fixture, not independent observations. Different source hashes, offsets, exports and receipts do not establish independence; no independence decisions or evidence units are asserted.
